title: fix(app-shell): Metadata Diagnostics header takes its tone from the sweep — no red alert over "All clear" (objectui#12721)
body:
Fixes #12721
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The Metadata Diagnostics header (Setup, then Configuration, then Diagnostics) no longer paints a clean sweep as an error. Before, the h1 always carried a red alert triangle and the summary badge always used destructive colours, even above the body's own "All clear".

The header now takes its tone from the entries the page already reads from `/meta/diagnostics`. That envelope carries only `total`, with no split by severity, so the tone is read from each entry's `diagnostics`. There is no new fetch and no invented severity.

- Any entry that is invalid or carries errors: destructive (unchanged).
- Warnings only (the "Errors + Warnings" tab): the amber warning colour, matching the existing per-row warning badge.
- No entries: a green check icon and a neutral badge. The badge keeps the existing `engine.diagnostics.summary` text, so there is no new string key.

While the sweep is loading, the badge is hidden and the icon is muted, instead of showing a placeholder "0 issue(s) across 0 items". When the sweep fails, the badge is hidden and the icon stays destructive, beside the page's load-failure notice. A failed sweep is never shown as clean.

Files: `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/DiagnosticsPage.tsx`, a test beside it, and `.changeset/12721-diagnostics-header-tone.md` (app-shell patch).

## Evidence

- Test `DiagnosticsPage.headerTone-12721.test.tsx` runs the real `useGlobalDiagnostics` against a fake client. It covers four cases: zero issues has no alert glyph and no destructive class; errors are destructive; warnings only are amber; a failed sweep is not clean. All four pass.
- Ablation, run once and not kept as a test:
  - Forcing the tone helper back to an unconditional error turns the zero-issue and warnings-only tests red.
  - Removing the error branch and the failed-sweep branch turns the other two red.
  - Each leg was restored to the HEAD blob and checked by hash.
- Screenshots at 1280 px, against a live backend (published `@objectstack/cli` 18.0.0-next.2, stock showcase): branch `claude/issue-12721-evidence`, folder `evidence/12721/` (before and after PNGs).
  - Before: icon `lucide-triangle-alert … text-destructive`, and a red badge reading "0 issue(s) across 395 items in 27 types" above "All clear".
  - After: icon `lucide-circle-check … text-emerald-600`, and a badge in `text-muted-foreground`.
- Local gates: app-shell dependency build, `type-check`, eslint on the changed files, the claims/changeset/test-path-roots/spec-symbols/new-line-citations checks, and the changeset-presence check all exit 0. The other test families that name the page also pass, as does the i18n census suite.

## Acceptance notes

- The metadata directory's "N issues" link (`DirectoryPage.tsx`, key `engine.directory.diagnosticsLink`) reads diagnostics with severity `warning`. It is styled destructive whenever the count is above zero, so an app with only warnings would see a red link there. This was read from code, not measured in a browser. It is outside this claim's file surface, so the seat files it as its own card.
